name: apple-calendar-mcp
description: Read and manage Apple Calendar and Reminders on your Mac: events, free time, conflicts, undo.
long_description:
Works with every account synced into macOS Calendar (iCloud, Google, Exchange and others) through Apple's EventKit, locally on your Mac. Find free time, check your agenda and conflicts, create and move events (including one occurrence of a repeating event), preview and undo changes, import and export .ics files, and manage reminders.

On first start it installs a small helper app at ~/Applications/Apple Calendar MCP.app. macOS then asks once for access to "Apple Calendar MCP": choose Allow Full Access for Calendar (and for Reminders, if you use them). Nothing leaves your Mac.

tools.name: get_time_context

tools.name: list_calendars

tools.name: agenda

tools.name: find_conflicts

tools.name: list_changes

tools.description: Undo a change made through this extension.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: Reminders, filtered by list, status, due date or text.

tools.description: Add a reminder with an optional due date and priority.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Change a reminder or move it to another list.

tools.name: delete_reminder
